name: Splunk — hunting playbook
description: Windows and network hunts built on Windows event codes and CIM fields. Set the index variable before running anything on a large deployment.

templates.name: Failed logons per account and source
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" EventCode=4625 earliest=-{{var:range}}
| stats count AS failures, dc(Account_Name) AS accounts, values(Failure_Reason) AS reasons,
        min(_time) AS first_seen, max(_time) AS last_seen
        BY Source_Network_Address
| where failures > 10
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - failures

templates.name: Successful logon from a source that was failing
templates.description: Correlates 4625 and 4624 on the same source address.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) earliest=-{{var:range}}
| stats count(eval(EventCode=4625)) AS failures, count(eval(EventCode=4624)) AS successes,
        values(Account_Name) AS accounts
        BY Source_Network_Address
| where failures >= 20 AND successes > 0
| sort - failures

templates.name: Accounts created or enabled
templates.description: Events 4720 and 4722, the persistence step after privilege escalation.

templates.name: PowerShell script blocks with encoded payloads
templates.description: Event 4104 script block logging. Requires script block logging to be enabled.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational" EventCode=4104 earliest=-{{var:range}}
| regex ScriptBlockText="(?i)(FromBase64String|-enc\\s|-EncodedCommand|DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|Net\\.WebClient)"
| table _time, host, user, ScriptBlockText
| sort - _time

templates.name: Living off the land binaries executed
templates.description: Event 4688 or Sysmon 1, restricted to the usual suspects with a remote argument.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} (EventCode=4688 OR (sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventCode=1)) earliest=-{{var:range}}
| search (New_Process_Name="*\\certutil.exe" OR New_Process_Name="*\\bitsadmin.exe" OR New_Process_Name="*\\mshta.exe" OR New_Process_Name="*\\regsvr32.exe" OR New_Process_Name="*\\rundll32.exe" OR Image="*\\certutil.exe" OR Image="*\\mshta.exe")
| regex CommandLine="(?i)(https?://|ftp://|\\\\\\\\)"
| table _time, host, user, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine
| sort - _time

templates.name: Services installed
templates.description: Event 7045 from the System log, a persistence and lateral movement staple.

templates.name: Scheduled tasks registered
templates.description: Event 4698 plus the schtasks command line variant.

templates.name: Event logs cleared
templates.description: Events 1102 and 104. Rare, loud, and almost always worth an incident.

templates.name: Endpoint protection disabled or tampered with
templates.description: Defender configuration changes and exclusions added.

templates.name: Rarest user agents on the proxy
templates.description: Frequency analysis: malware rarely bothers to blend into the top of the list.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} http_user_agent=*
| stats count AS requests, dc(src) AS clients, values(dest) AS destinations BY http_user_agent
| where requests < 20
| sort requests

templates.name: Long lived outbound sessions
templates.description: Beaconing and tunnels show up as unusually long or unusually regular sessions.
templates.body:
index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} duration=*
| where duration > 3600
| stats count AS sessions, sum(duration) AS total_seconds, values(dest_port) AS ports BY src_ip, dest_ip
| sort - total_seconds
| head 100
